## Summary

Describe the integration behavior or documentation changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm ci --ignore-scripts`
- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] Relevant examples and fixtures were exercised.

## Compatibility and trust

- [ ] The change is backward-compatible within v1, or it introduces a new major version with migration guidance.
- [ ] New fields are optional; unknown capabilities or extensions remain safely ignorable.
- [ ] No deployment, partner support, finality, approval, or security claim exceeds its attached evidence.
- [ ] `prelaunch`, `sample`, provisional, finalized, and live data remain clearly distinct.
- [ ] Metadata and extensions cannot override provenance, lifecycle, fee, or security fields.
- [ ] No metadata, extension, fixture, or project URL is treated as an executable transaction payload.
- [ ] No secret, private key, access token, personal data, or unpublished exploit detail is included.

## Evidence

Link the affected schema, fixture, transaction, block, Registry proof, or documentation source. Use exact commits and
versions rather than mutable branch links where practical.
